question:
Study the following line graph carefully and answer the question.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a2f621a7507e6b7cef63087975cad5dd29b539b16f040fe95b4b23b6c0c800d3.png] 

Supposing if in 2020, the average value of goods sold per container was same as that of 2019, then what would be the new approximate value of total exports (in crores) in 2020 if number of containers in 2020 remains unchanged?
solution: **Solution:** Value of total export in 2019 = 280 cr Number of containers in 2019 = 130 Average value of goods sold per container in 2019 = 280/130 = 2.15 cr If number of containers in 2020 remains unchanged then new approximate value of total exports (in crores) in 2020 = 2.15 × 180 = 387 cr
